name: Engineered Plastic Components
old_description: Leading North American supplier of engineered plastic components for automotive, appliances, medical, and consumer industries
about:
Engineered Plastic Components (EPC Manufacturing) is headquartered in Lebanon, Kentucky, and operates a network of 21 manufacturing facilities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The company serves as a Tier 1 supplier to automotive OEMs and provides molded components for appliance, medical device, and consumer product manufacturers.

The company specializes in injection molding with press capacities ranging from 25 to 4,400 tons, offering two-shot molding, overmolding, insert molding, gas assist, and in-mold decoration. Secondary operations include sonic, hot plate, spin, and vibration welding; pad printing, silk screening, hot stamping, and heat transfer; as well as interior and exterior painting, powder coating, and full assembly and sub-assembly. Facilities such as the 250,000-square-foot Lebanon, Kentucky plant run 24/7, while the Osceola, Wisconsin site maintains ISO 13485 certification and IQ/OQ/PQ validations for medical device packaging.

EPC supplies complex instrument panel assemblies, center consoles, door panels, and painted exterior trim to automotive manufacturers. For the appliance sector it produces control panels, structural housings, and components with heat resistance and UV stability. Medical customers receive precision housings for diagnostic equipment and surgical instrument components manufactured in FDA-compliant cleanrooms. Consumer product lines include electronic device housings and appliance parts made with recycled materials where specified.

The company emphasizes its North American footprint, 24/7 production capability, and integrated quality systems—including IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 13485 certifications across multiple sites—as key differentiators for supply chain reliability and regulatory compliance.
